body: Filemark CWS launch locked decisions 2026-05-25: Category = Developer Tools (filemark's depth — SQL/Prisma/DBML ER, 9-theme JSON, CSV/TSV datagrid, MDX + kanban + tasks + chart, markdown task DSL — fits dev audience; Productivity bucket is sea of generic md viewers, would lose SEO; Workflow & Planning too narrow). Landing + privacy = dedicated TanStack SPA at khanakia.com/apps/filemark/ mirroring khanakia_com/sql-schema-visualizer template (apps/web Vite + Tailwind v4 + TanStack Router, base:/apps/filemark/), deployed as per-app Cloudflare Worker (Static Assets), registered in khanakia_com_cfare_gateway apps-registry.csv → KV → routes through khanakia.com/apps/* gateway pattern. Full landing scope: hero + features + interactive playground embed + screenshots gallery + changelog + privacy. Screenshots via Playwright headed Chromium with --load-extension=apps/chrome-ext/dist (captures REAL extension UI, not just renderers). Support email = khanakia@gmail.com. Plan = docsi/CWS_PUBLISH_PLAN.md; tasks = docsi/TASKS.md § M-CWS (phased: A scaffold → A.deploy → B copy → C assets → D submission). Mechanical CWS runbook (OAuth/refresh-token/release) already exists in docsi/PUBLISHING.md.
